_note: The sample family a new tablet starts with. A parent changes it behind the gear; their family stays on that tablet (localStorage ssb.family) and is never in this repo, the site or any AI model. Books name these slots: {grownup1} in text, {"who":"person","slot":"grownup1"} as an actor. An optional member can be switched out ("out": true) and books leave them out. siblings is never set by hand: it is every kid but the one starring in this reading (a family adds kids on the family screen; with one kid it is out).
